prompt: Write 10 distinct short extracts of Larkmere Mutual's official guidance, procedures or policy wording about: a fence blown down. Two to four sentences each, in the society's own formal voice. Use type "fact". Return {"items": [{"type": "fact" | "preference" | "observation", "content": "..."}]} with exactly 10 items. (batch 1)
response: {"items":[{"type":"fact","content":"If a fence is blown down in a storm, we will consider whether the damage was caused by an insured event and whether the fence formed part of the insured property.
